sources.title: simaai/LFM2-VL-3B-a16w4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository contains the LFM2-VL-3B model, optimized and compiled for the SiMa.ai Modalix platform. Model Architecture: LFM2-VL (3B parameters) Quantization: Hybrid Prompt Processing: A16W8 (16-bit activations, 8-bit weights) Token Generation: A16W4 (16-bit activations, 4-bit weights) Maximum context length: 2048 Input Resolution: 512x512 ...

sources.title: simaai/LFM2-VL-3B-Autoround-Safetensors · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a post-training quantized version of LiquidAI/LFM2-VL-3B, prepared as a Hugging Face checkpoint for LLiMa compilation and Sima.ai deployment. The source model's license and use restrictions continue to apply.

sources.title: LFM2-VL-3B: A New Efficient Vision-Language for the Edge
sources.snippet: We're excited to release LFM2-VL-3B, the newest and most capable addition to our family of vision LFMs (450M and 1.6B). Built on the LFM2-2.6B backbone, this 3B parameter model targets applications that require more accuracy while maintaining the speed advantage of the LFM2 architecture. It is available today on LEAP and Hugging Face.
